text:
Star X has a larger diameter than star Y but they both emit radiation with the same power.
Which statement is correct?
A
The surface temperature of X is less than the surface temperature of Y.
B
The surface temperatures of X and Y are the same.
C
The surface temperature of X is greater than the surface temperature of Y.
D
The surface areas of X and Y are the same.

options.label: A
options.text: The surface temperature of X is less than the surface temperature of Y.

options.label: B
options.text: The surface temperatures of X and Y are the same.

options.label: C
options.text: The surface temperature of X is greater than the surface temperature of Y.

options.label: D
options.text: The surface areas of X and Y are the same.
